description: Details required by Condition 13 (Tree Protection) of Planning Permission PP/25/01139 (Demolition of single storey rear extension, brick out building at first floor and removal of external metal fire escape staircases, for an extension at rear to form a new three storey mews house with private front garden and first floor roof terrace. Change of use within Class E (restaurant) to (office) to the basement and partial ground floor, with remaining ground floor change of use to C3 (residential) for entrance to upper floors, with change of use of existing first floor Class E (restaurant) to C3 (residential) to form a 2No. bedroom apartment and 1No. bedroom duplex apartment, with partial rear extension at second floor and reuse existing terraces as amenity space. Existing 2 bedroom apartment to the second and 2 bedroom apartment to the third retained with a new rear balcony to third floor apartment)
